title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: OLG Stage, Niagara Falls | 2024
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the OLG Stage, part of the Fallsview Casino in Niagara Falls, Canada, on 22 September 2024.

It was the 22nd and final show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s 2024 tour. Two subsequent shows, in Philadelphia and New York City, were cancelled due to Starr suffering from illness.

Starr had previously performed at the Fallsview Casino on 14 and 15 June 2012.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
